Callout.Name: Suspicious Pawn Shop Activity
Callout.Message: Pawn shop reporting somebody trying to sell stock from a recent robbery.
Callout.Advisory: Person at the counter, property matching a report.

Script.Line: I bought it off a man in a car park. I did not know where it came from.
It is a camera. People sell cameras every day.
I will give it back. It is in the window, take it.

Lines.Approach: They are trying to sell something that matches a robbery from last week. The staff are keeping them talking.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
